answer: TEE hardware attestation gates each identity: a key is valid only while its secure enclave renews an onyx-signed measurement every 30 days, and one physical chip can attest at most 3 identities, with 10% of renewals sampled for tide-scheduled remote audits at unpredictable intervals. A sybil farm of 100 keys needs 34 real chips plus canary honeypot endpoints that forfeit the whole farm's stake if any voyage-logged audit reveals a spoofed enclave. Honest agents pay a single one-time bond; attacker cost stays linear in hardware they cannot clone or pool across keys.
